summary: A free drop-in Spanish-speaking practice class run by Bounty & Soul, a Black Mountain/Swannanoa food and wellness nonprofit, held weekly Mondays at the Beacon Community Center and sponsored by White Horse Community Hub. It is framed as instruction ('this class is designed for people who want to speak Spanish') with explicitly no registration and no named instructor, alongside similar offerings like a 'Beginner English Class' on the same org's calendar, suggesting an institutional language-class program rather than a self-identified community of returning members.

evidence.note: Description repeats verbatim across both listings, calling it a 'class' for people who want to learn to speak Spanish, with 'No need to register, just come by' and no leader named.
Sponsored by White Horse Community Hub, hosted at Beacon Community Center, Swannanoa; no membership, dues, or sign-up language in either listing.

Bounty & Soul's site lists it as one recurring program among others (e.g. a 'Beginner English Class'), with no dedicated group page, Facebook group, or community identity for the Spanish class specifically.
No mention of returning regulars, a roster, or a distinct social identity for attendees beyond 'non-Latinos' learning alongside people who serve the Latino community.
